sources.title: Councils in Action: Automating the Curation of Municipal Governance Data for Research
sources.snippet: Large scale comparative research into municipal governance is often prohibitively difficult due to a lack of high-quality data. But, recent advances in speech-to-text algorithms and natural language processing has made it possible to more easily collect and analyze data about municipal governments.
